description: Creates one API key for the specified organization. An organization API key grants programmatic access to an organization.. Source:- https://github.com/mongodb/mongodbatlas-cloudformation-resources/tree/master/cfn-resources/api-key

PageNum.description: Number of the page that displays the current set of the total objects that the response returns.

ItemsPerPage.description: Number of items that the response returns per page.

IncludeCount.description: Flag that indicates whether the response returns the total number of items (totalCount) in the response.

Roles.description: List of roles to grant this API key. If you provide this list, provide a minimum of one role and ensure each role applies to this organization.

ProjectId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project in an organization.

Description.description: Purpose or explanation provided when someone created this organization API key.

AwsSecretName.description: Name of the AWS Secrets Manager secret that stores the API key Details.

OrgId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization that contains your projects. Use the /orgs endpoint to retrieve all organizations to which the authenticated user has access.

Profile.description: Profile used to provide credentials information, (a secret with the cfn/atlas/profile/{Profile}, is required), if not provided default is used

AwsSecretArn.description: ARN of the AWS Secrets Manager secret that stores the API key Details

Roles.description: List of roles to grant this API key. If you provide this list, provide a minimum of one role and ensure each role applies to this organization.
